findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. These credentials are exposed in source control and Terraform state, and can be extracted by anyone with access to those artifacts or the function configuration.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed function.
